يستصدر (form X)

# يُسْتَصْدَرُ (yustaṣdaru) /jus.tasˤ.da.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
# يَسْتَصْدِرَ (yastaṣdira) /jas.tasˤ.di.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَصْ
